title: Holiday Apple Butternut Squash Soup
description: A creamy squash soup with apples and sweet potatoes is seasoned for cool weather with brown sugar and Chinese five-spice powder.
ingredients: 2 cups Swanson® Chicken Broth (regular, Natural Goodness™ or Certified Organic)
2 pounds butternut squash - peeled, seeded and cut into 1-inch cubes
1 Gala apple - peeled, cored, and diced
0.5 cup dry white wine (such as Chardonnay)

steps.text: Combine Swanson® Chicken Broth, squash, carrots, apple, and butter in stock pot. Bring to a boil over medium-high heat; reduce heat to low and simmer until vegetables and apple are soft, about 20 minutes. Remove from heat. Puree mixture using an immersion blender or potato masher.
Stir in white wine, cream, brown sugar, and five-spice powder. Place pot over low heat and simmer until heated through, stirring constantly, about 10 minutes.
